name: 1inch
description: Search 1inch developer documentation and read 1inch Aqua analytics from ChatGPT. Documentation search, SDK examples, maker stats, strategies, activity and volume. No swaps, no limit orders, no position writes and no account required.

interface.longDescription: Answer questions about 1inch APIs and SDKs, and read 1inch Aqua shared-liquidity analytics: maker TVL, fees, APY, strategies, activity and volume. Read-only by design — it cannot prepare or send a transaction, and it needs no 1inch account.
